    • AstralDJ
      5 out of 5 stars
      A Powerful and Capable Do-It-All in 2024!
      Reviewed in the United States on 2 October 2024
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      This iPad Air is an absolute powerhouse and is able to accomplish so many of the things that you would typically do in your day to day that the Pro model almost doesn't seem worth it. To start, this iPad is thin, light, and takes up virtually no space in most work bags and backpacks. It is easy to take on the go, and the battery life is incredible. This iPad is also compatible with the Apple Pencil, which makes sketching and taking notes a simple task.

      For me, however, the best part about this iPad is the power under the hood. The M1 chip is capable of running virtually any iOS app flawlessly, and honestly makes the MacBook feel like an accessory. I've used this to play multiple mobile games with high frame rates, edit videos on the go, and for watching videos when sitting in waiting rooms. I haven't had any issues with apps slowing down or freezing, and it is capable of doing anything I need. When using it with an add-on keyboard, it really does make the MacBook and other computing devices feel obsolete as it has so much processing power even in 2024. The iPad also has a built-in front and rear camera for taking photos, recording videos or to FaceTime your coworkers or family. The quality of these cameras are not the greatest, but are still nice to have. The speakers also get very loud and sound good overall but there is a bit of thinness to some details in various movie scenes and songs. The only real complaint I have is the limited storage space, but as long as you aren't taking too many photos or working on too many projects at a time, the storage is more than enough.

      Overall, this iPad still holds its own in 2024, as when it is on sale, it is an absolute steal. I would highly recommend getting this for those uncertain on what to choose, and I must say I have been very happy with it!

    • MsB
      5 out of 5 stars
      Excellent Upgrade! Fast, Fast, Fast!
      Reviewed in the United States on 14 November 2022
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Started using an IPad back when the IPad 2 was the latest and greatest thing… 2011… Every two years I have purchased a new model. I have also used a work issued model for creating projects, e- learning and screen casting with students- You name it, I have just about done it or seen it done with an IPad, …

      My favorite Internet connected device by far!

      My latest upgrade was just made to this IPad Air, 5th edition. I had hoped to wait until after the New Year to update to a new model — old one was still working well enough… But, darn it all if Amazon didn’t take 8O.$ off the price and neatly offer their deal as an early, Black-Friday option. I checked the Apple web site and other well known retail spots, and all had the same- much higher- retail price - So I pounced!

      The order came to my door about 4 hours after ordered- was turned on, updated, and in use soon after that.

      This is absolutely the quickest connecting IPad I have used… one of the lightest, and definitely the fastest web surfing tablet I have touched. I like the visual design with no home button and narrower bezels, but was unsure how use would actually be without the dedicated button onboard. I had recently set up an accessibility optioned home button on my IPhone - so after checking the settings on the new IPad, found I could do the same thing. If you are unsure about not having the home button, or concerned an older family member might not have a good experience without the familiar setup, you can make one using the accessibility settings and place it anywhere on the screen you like. Everything else on this IPad Air is a major improvement. Do not hesitate to pay a smidge more for the Air as the tablet itself is well made, beautiful and good enough to replace a laptop when paired with a keyboard and mouse. I do not use the pencil so cannot comment on that, but if you take the time to read about tricks and tips in the new operating system-this one is ready to use for a good long while. Merry Christmas to myself, and no regrets… Absolutely a great buy, a great product, and an overall good order and delivery experience. (be sure to get a case for your new IPad… makes a difference in experience and longevity for sure…) 😎

      Reviewed in the United States on 30 September 2025

      Performance is phenomenal. Thanks to the M1 chip, this tablet handles everything from heavy photo editing to intensive gaming with ease, offering Pro-level power in a lighter body. It’s incredibly fast and completely future-proof.

      The 10.9-inch Liquid Retina display is vibrant and sharp, perfect for media and creativity. It fully supports the Apple Pencil 2 and accessories like the Magic Keyboard, transforming it into a versatile work or study tool.       If you want a powerful, modern, and high-quality tablet without paying the price for an iPad Pro, the iPad Air 5 is the clear choice. It’s simply the best value iPad available.
